cap: Age narrows the differential before any test. A mobile mass under 35 is usually a fibroadenoma, cyclic lumpiness before menopause is fibrocystic change, and a new mass after menopause is carcinoma until proven otherwise. In men, gynecomastia peaks in newborns, at puberty and in older age, and it sits centered under the areola, whereas male breast cancer is a late, hard, eccentric mass.
